cases.action: I sit at the end of the dock and watch the river go by.
I ask Odette what brought her to the landing.
I lean on the ferry rail and think about the home I left behind.
Halfway across, I hear the ferry rope start to fray.
I pry up a loose board on the dock and look at what is hidden underneath.
I ask the ferryman for his real name, and I wait until he answers.
